title: Bind source repositories and worktrees by verified identity, not ownership

checkpoint.summary: V2-08 complete. Pinned independently verified source Git endpoint identity, source branch/base/target and generation, with explicit versioned source rebind and read-only registered worktree observations independent of agent ownership. Immutable review/integration provenance verifies approved source fetch/push endpoints; historical review revisions survive branch moves and rebinds. Experimental protocol 3.31. Implementation commit b4ff0dd.
checkpoint.nextAction: V2-08 accepted. V2-05 independent provenance dependency is satisfied; continue V2-06 reviewer-claim recovery or V2-09 task-spec API after reviewing task dependencies. No push, deployment, ledger initialization or V1 migration was performed.
